steps: Wash the cucumbers and pat them dry with a clean towel.
Make the dressing by combining the salt, sugar, sesame oil, light soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Stir until the sugar and salt are completely dissolved, then set aside.
On a cutting board, lay a large knife flat against each cucumber and smash it lightly with your other hand until it cracks open into sections. Repeat along the full length.
Cut the smashed cucumber at a 45-degree angle into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, mix the cucumber with the prepared dressing, garlic, and chili oil. Toss well.
Serve garnished with toasted sesame seeds and chopped cilantro.
